blocking_failures: behavior_in_tests: Tests cover the main fixture, intervals, tenant isolation, duplicates, empty results, and a large export, but do not exercise every required tie-break dimension or ordering of requests sharing an ingestion sequence.
deterministic_tests: The dense-export test asserts a wall-clock runtime below 20 seconds, so a correct implementation can fail due to machine load or environment variance.
valid_failure_modes: Verification depends on downloading uv and packages from the network and includes a strict wall-clock performance cutoff, creating failures unrelated to solution correctness.
